name: fmp_treasury_rates
description:
US Treasury yield curve history from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/treasury): daily yields for maturities from 1 month to 30 years, in percent.
Returns {rates}: FMP's list of daily records, one per date.
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); both optional.
For macro events use fmp_economic_calendar; for equity risk premia fmp_market_risk_premium.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-01-01", "to_date": "2025-01-31"}
